snippet.title: Himiko - Steam Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Himiko on: http://store.steampowered.com/app/603740/

Himiko is a short dark atmospheric horror puzzle game with a very complicated story but rather simple gameplay. The game requires the player to understand the story in order to progress through the game. There are secret notes in the game that don't actually exist in the game universe, they are only there to help you understand the story.

Games reviews and download: http://download.online-games.co/
